The other LiAlSiO4 polymorph (mp-aaabfumz) was not acceptable (bin 10), so polymorph choice matters and a close composition in the same silicate family is the next step.

proposal.hypothesis: Li5Al(SiO4)2 is a Li-rich aluminosilicate with the same fully oxidized Al3+/Si4+ framework as Li3AlSiO5, the only acceptable contact so far. Its high Li content and fully oxidized cations should avoid reducible P, S, or Cl centers and limit reactions with Li6PS5Cl. It is a close compositional neighbour of the acceptable phase, so it is the most direct test of whether Li-richness in this family keeps the penalty low.
